senses.gloss: m. (v. בָּחַשׁ) a sort of gnat, a (red) insect found in liquids. Tosef. Yad. (T’bul Yom) II, 3 י׳ שבריתו וכ׳ a yabḥush which originates in the water.—Pl. יַבְחוּשִׁים, יַבְחוּשִׁין.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:2">Nidd. III, 2</cite> <he>כמין י׳ אדומים</he> looking like a mass of red insects; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 4:2">Tosef. ib. IV, 2</cite>.
